annotations.title: Deep Semantic LLM Governance & Contract Audit (x402)

description: Stage 2 Paid ($0.05 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet) hybrid audit combining Stage 1 on-chain gatekeeping with Stage 2 Gemini LLM evaluation to verify proposal_description claims against target_address bytecode and calldata under policy_prompt. Non-idempotent due to LLM evaluation and single-use EIP-3009 x402_payment_header nonce; omitting x402_payment_header safely returns an HTTP 402 payment challenge without charging. Breaching risk_threshold (0.0-10.0) escalates decision to REJECT. Returns JSON with status, decision (APPROVE, MANUAL_REVIEW, REJECT), risk_score, reasoning, and flagged_issues.

calldata.description: Transaction hex calldata or function selector being executed

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (default: 8453 for Base Mainnet)

policy_prompt.default: Audit contract and proposal for unauthorized privilege escalation, proxy upgrades, honeypot traps, or treasury drainage.
policy_prompt.description: Security policy or governance criteria to audit against

proposal_description.description: Natural language claim or governance proposal description explaining the intent of the transaction

risk_threshold.description: Risk score threshold (0.0 to 10.0) above which the audit triggers rejection or alert

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract under evaluation

x402_payment_header.description: Optional Base64-encoded EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization payment header satisfying $0.05 USDC requirement

name: deep_semantic_audit
